units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15<sup>22</sup></cite> <he>שלשה בריות … המים והר׳ וכ׳</he> three creations preceded the formation of the world: water, air, and fire; <he>הר׳ הרה וכ׳</he> the air (spirit) conceived and gave birth to wisdom.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:3">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>הכל בר׳</he> all (diseases) are caused by the air.
<cite ref="Chagigah 12a:6">Ḥag. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>עשרה … ר׳ ומים וכ׳</he> ten things were created on the first day: heaven …, air and water &c.
<cite ref="Chagigah 12b:13">Ib. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>הרים בר׳</he> the mountains are sustained by the air, <he>ר׳ בסערה</he> the air by the wind-storm.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:22">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>יכול … לכל ר׳ שירצה</he> you may think a man may pray facing any direction he may desire.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 22b:8">B. Bath. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>מר׳ אחת</he> from one side.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:9">Ib. II, 9</cite> <he>לכל ר׳ עושה וכ׳</he> one may erect a tannery on any side of the town except the western.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 25b:6">Ib. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ דרומית</he> the southern wind.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5:5">Kil. V, 5</cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>רוּחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:17">Ab. III, 17</cite> <he>שאפי׳ כל הר׳ וכ׳</he> even if all the winds were to come and blow at them &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 3:1">Kil. III, 1</cite> <he>בארבע ר׳ הערוגה</he> on the four sides of the bed. Y. ib. VI, end, 30ᶜ <he>מגופף מארבע רוּחוֹתָיו</he> enclosed on its four sides.
<cite ref="Pesachim 94a:10">Pes. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>לארבע ר׳ העולם</he> he may turn towards any of the four directions of the world; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:10">Ab. III, 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00340"><he>נוּחַ</he></cite> h.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:28">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> bot., a. e., v. <cite ref="E00672"><he>הֲנָחָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:7">Ab. IV, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01161"><he>גַּס</he> III</cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:19">Ib. V, 19</cite> <he>ר׳ נמוכה</he> a lowly spirit; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 7">Gen. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>נפש חיה זה רוּחוֹ של וכ׳</he> ‘a living soul’ (<cite ref="Genesis 2:19">Gen. II, 19</cite>), this means the soul of Adam.

Gen. R. s. 2 ורוח אלהים זו רוחו וכ׳ ‘and the spirit of God’ (Gen. I, 2), this means the soul of the king Messiah; a. v. fr.—Esp. ר׳ הקדש (abbr. רוה״ק) the holy spirit, prophetic inspiration, intuition.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 20b:11">Ab. Zar. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>קדושה … רוה״ק</he> sanctity (of life) leads to prophetic inspiration.
<cite ref="Megillah 7a:8">Meg. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>אסתר ברוה״ק וכ׳</he> the Book of Esther was composed in a spirit of prophecy.
<cite ref="Yoma 9b:16">Yoma 9ᵇ</cite> <he>משמתו … נסתלקה רוה״ק וכ׳</he> with the death of the last prophets, Haggai …, the prophetic spirit was withdrawn from Israel.

<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:21">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>חזאי לי ברוה״ק וכ׳</he> I saw in a prophetic vision that unworthy children would go forth &c.; a. v. fr.—Snḥ. 65ᵇ, a. fr. <he>ר׳ טומאה</he> unholy inspiration (augury &c.).

<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:2">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ רעה</he> (<he>סכנת</he>) the danger threatening from an evil spirit; a. fr.—<he>ר׳ צרדה</he>, <he>ר׳ צרעת</he>, <he>ר׳ תזזית</he> &c., v. respective determinants.—Pl. <he>רוּחוֹת</he>, <he>רוּחִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:11">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>ר׳ הזכרים</he> male demons; <he>ר׳ נקבות</he> female demons.
<cite ref="Eruvin 18b:10">Erub. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>הוליד ר׳ ושדין וכ׳</he> begot spirits and demons &c.; a. fr.
